description: This PHP source file defines the class Vtiger_Feed_Parser, which extends the SimplePie library to provide custom feed parsing functionalities for vtiger CRM, specifically for handling RSS/ATOM feeds with additional cache and fetch control.

classes.name: Vtiger_Feed_Parser
classes.description: Custom feed parser class extending SimplePie for vtiger CRM, adding cache location and custom fetch methods.

methods.name: vt_dofetch
methods.description: Sets up the feed URL, timeout, and options for fetching and parsing a feed, marking fetch as done.

methods.name: vt_doparse
methods.description: Sets raw data for the feed parser to parse directly from content, marking parse as done.
